tspan.tspan: Load Debtor Finance temporary acct table
1. @jobname These jobs run last business day of the week but NOT when the last business day of the week
and last business day of the month fall on the same calendar day.
2. %jobname These jobs run last business day of the month
3. You will see that wherever there is a @jobname on the flow there is a %jobname job opposite.
4. Other job (nwpbtab3) will run on last business day of the week and month.
